script.title: He Found the Lost City of Petra in Disguise, With a Goat
sentences: A Swiss traveller went looking for a lost city with a goat.
It was 1812, and Johann Ludwig Burckhardt was on his way to explore the Niger River.
Then he heard about a dead city that held the tomb of the Prophet Aaron.
The West had not known it for centuries.
He already spoke fluent Arabic, so he dressed as a local.
The goat came along to be sacrificed in honor of Aaron's Tomb.
One day of exploring was enough to convince him he had found Petra.
Close to a million tourists visit every year now, no goat needed.
script.description:
In 1812 a Swiss traveller in disguise found a city unknown to the West for centuries.
His plan involved fluent Arabic and a goat.
claims_en: In 1812 Swiss traveller Johann Ludwig Burckhardt reached Petra.
He brought a goat with him.
He was on his way to explore the Niger River.
He heard stories of a dead city that held the tomb of the Prophet Aaron.
Petra remained unknown to the western world until 1812, after being abandoned by the early Islamic era.
He dressed himself up as a local.
He intended to sacrifice the goat in honor of Aaron's Tomb.
After one day of exploring he was convinced he had found the lost city of Petra.
Close to a million tourists visit Petra every year.
